verdict.rationale: Community-thread evidence shows a Metal-based inference engine (MetalRT) for Apple Silicon. It uses Metal 3.1 GPU features and benchmarks competitively, winning 3 of 4 runs against uzu. However, it requires M3 or later, M1/M2 fall back to llama.cpp, and the GitHub README claims acceleration only in general terms. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Metal/ARM optimizations, evidence of native ARM-specific optimization, M1/M2 MetalRT support, and independent benchmark corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: MetalRT uses Metal 3.1 GPU features available on M3, M3 Pro, M3 Max, M4, and later chips. M1/M2 support is coming soon, falling back to open-source llama.cpp engine.
Accelerated by whatever silicon the device has.
